H7307: wind; by resemblance breath, i.e. a sensible (or even violent) exhalation; figuratively, life, anger, unsubstantiality; by extension, a region of the sky; by resemblance spirit, but only of a rational being (including its expression and functions)
H2254: to wind tightly (as a rope), i.e. to bind; specifically, by a pledge; figuratively, to pervert, destroy; also to writhe in pain (especially of parturition)
H3117: a day (as the warm hours), whether literal (from sunrise to sunset, or from one sunset to the next), or figurative (a space of time defined by an associated term), (often used adverb)
H518: used very widely as demonstrative, lo!; interrogative, whether?; or conditional, if, although; also Oh that!, when; hence, as a negative, not
H3808: not (the simple or abs. negation); by implication, no; often used with other particles
H4784: to be (causatively, make) bitter (or unpleasant); (figuratively) to rebel (or resist; causatively, to provoke)
H3885: to stop (usually over night); by implication, to stay permanently; hence (in a bad sense) to be obstinate (especially in words, to complain)
H5869: an eye (literally or figuratively); by analogy, a fountain (as the eye of the landscape)
H7760: to put (used in a great variety of applications, literal, figurative, inferentially, and elliptically)
H4994: 'I pray', 'now', or 'then'; added mostly to verbs (in the Imperative or Future), or to interjections, occasionally to an adverb or conjunction
H6148: to braid, i.e. intermix; technically, to traffic (as if by barter); also or give to be security (as a kind of exchange)
H5973: adverb or preposition, with (i.e. in conjunction with), in varied applications; specifically, equally with; often with prepositional prefix (and then usually unrepresented in English)
H4310: who? (occasionally, by a peculiar idiom, of things); also (indefinitely) whoever; often used in oblique construction with prefix or suffix
H1931: he (she or it); only expressed when emphatic or without a verb; also (intensively) self, or (especially with the article) the same; sometimes (as demonstrative) this or that; occasionally (instead of copula) as or are
H3027: a hand (the open one (indicating power, means, direction, etc.),
H8628: to clatter, i.e. slap (the hands together), clang (an instrument); by analogy, to drive (a nail or tent-pin, a dart, etc.); by implication, to become bondsman by handclasping)
H3588: (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb (as below); often largely modified by other particles annexed
H3820: the heart; also used (figuratively) very widely for the feelings, the will and even the intellect; likewise for the centre of anything
H6845: to hide (by covering over); by implication, to hoard or reserve; figuratively to deny; specifically (favorably) to protect, (unfavorably) to lurk
H5921: above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
H3651: properly, set upright; hence (figuratively as adjective) just; but usually (as adverb or conjunction) rightly or so (in various applications to manner, time and relation; often with other particles)
H7311: to be high actively, to rise or raise (in various applications, literally or figuratively)
H2506: properly, smoothness (of the tongue); also an allotment
H5046: properly, to front, i.e. stand boldly out opposite; by implication (causatively), to manifest; figuratively, to announce (always by word of mouth to one present); specifically, to expose, predict, explain, praise
H1121: a son (as a builder of the family name), in the widest sense (of literal and figurative relationship, including grandson, subject, nation, quality or condition, etc., (like father or brother), etc.)
H3615: to end, whether intransitive (to cease, be finished, perish) or transitived (to complete, prepare, consume)
H5971: a people (as a congregated unit); specifically, a tribe (as those of Israel); hence (collectively) troops or attendants; figuratively, a flock
H6440: the face (as the part that turns); used in a great variety of applications (literally and figuratively); also (with prepositional prefix) as a preposition (before, etc.)
H1961: to exist, i.e. be or become, come to pass (always emphatic, and not a mere copula or auxiliary)
H3543: to be weak, i.e. (figuratively) to despond (causatively, rebuke), or (of light, the eye) to grow dull
H3605: properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense)
H8074: to stun (or intransitively, grow numb), i.e. devastate or (figuratively) stupefy (both usually in a passive sense)
H270: to seize (often with the accessory idea of holding in possession)
H1870: a road (as trodden); figuratively, a course of life or mode of action, often adverb
H2891: to be pure (physical sound, clear, unadulterated; Levitically, uncontaminated; morally, innocent or holy)
H3254: to add or augment (often adverbial, to continue to do a thing)
H7725: to turn back (hence, away) transitively or intransitively, literally or figuratively (not necessarily with the idea of return to the starting point); generally to retreat; often adverbial, again
H935: to go or come (in a wide variety of applications)
H4672: properly, to come forth to, i.e. appear or exist; transitively, to attain, i.e. find or acquire; figuratively, to occur, meet or be present
H5674: to cross over; used very widely of any transition (literal or figurative; transitive, intransitive, intensive, causative); specifically, to cover (in copulation)
H2154: a plan, especially a bad one
H3824: the heart (as the most interior organ);
H3915: properly, a twist (away of the light), i.e. night; figuratively, adversity
H216: illumination or (concrete) luminary (in every sense, including lightning, happiness, etc.)
H2822: the dark; hence (literally) darkness; figuratively, misery, destruction, death, ignorance, sorrow, wickedness
H6960: to bind together (perhaps by twisting), i.e. collect; (figuratively) to expect
H7585: Hades or the world of the dead (as if a subterranean retreat), including its accessories and inmates
H1004: a house (in the greatest variation of applications, especially family, etc.)
H7502: to spread (a bed); by implication, to refresh
H3326: spread, i.e. a bed; (architecture) an extension, i.e. wing or lean-to (a single story or collectively)
H7845: a pit (especially as a trap); figuratively, destruction
H7121: to call out to (i.e. properly, address by name, but used in a wide variety of applications)
H1: father, in a literal and immediate, or figurative and remote application
H859: thou and thee, or (plural) ye and you
H517: a mother (as the bond of the family); in a wide sense (both literally and figuratively (like father))
H269: a sister (used very widely (like brother), literally and figuratively)
H7415: a maggot (as rapidly bred), literally or figuratively
H645: strictly a demonstrative particle, here; but used of time, now or then
H8615: literally a cord (as an attachment); figuratively, expectancy
H7789: to spy out, i.e. (generally) survey, (for evil) lurk for, (for good) care for
H905: properly, separation; by implication, a part of the body, branch of atree, bar forcarrying; figuratively, chief of a city; especially (with prepositional prefix) as an adverb, apart, only, besides
H3381: to descend (literally, to go downwards; or conventionally to a lower region, as the shore, a boundary, the enemy, etc.; or figuratively, to fall); causatively, to bring down (in all the above applications)
H6083: dust (as powdered or gray); hence, clay, earth, mud
H5183: a descent, i.e. imposition, unfavorable (punishment) or favorable (food); restfulness
